Submagic vs VEXI: Caption Editor or Your Social Media?
Submagic adds captions and B-roll to the short videos you upload, and schedules them. VEXI also designs posts, makes long-form video and posts everywhere.
Submagic is a fast editor for short-form captions. Here is how it compares with one app that runs your whole feed.

Submagic is an AI editor for short-form video. You upload a clip and it adds captions, removes silences and inserts B-roll; its Magic Clips turn one long video into several shorts. It publishes and schedules to TikTok, Instagram Reels and Stories and YouTube Shorts; scheduling for a later date needs Pro or Business. Starter is $19 a month ($12 billed yearly), Pro is $39 ($23) and Business is $69 ($41).

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.

Credit where it is due: Submagic edits your own footage well, and posts it. The difference is everything around the video. Submagic is a tool you drive, one upload at a time, for short video. VEXI also designs posts and carousels, writes the captions, makes long-form video, posts to more of your accounts, and Autopilot runs your week. VEXI costs more than Submagic: plans are $199, $399 or $599 a month. What you pay for is the work you no longer do.
Submagic edits video. It makes no designed posts or carousels.
VEXI designs the post with your logo, colors, fonts and voice. Tap anything on the design to change it.
Submagic posts to TikTok, Instagram and YouTube Shorts. Facebook, LinkedIn and X are not live yet.
VEXI posts to Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Threads and your Google Business Profile.
Each video starts with you uploading it and choosing the style. There is no mode that plans the week for you.
VEXI Autopilot runs your week ahead: it writes, cuts and posts, and can wait for your approval on everything.
Submagic is rated 4.5 on Trustpilot. Some reviewers report that stopping the payments is hard and refunds refused.
Designs posts and carousels in your brand
Edits your own footage: cuts, B-roll, music, captions
A fast, cheap way to caption and polish the short videos you upload, and post them to TikTok, Instagram and YouTube. It makes no designed posts and does not plan your week.
One app: you ask, and it writes, designs, edits the video and posts it. Autopilot runs your week ahead.
Does Submagic post to social media?

Yes, to TikTok, Instagram Reels and Stories and YouTube Shorts; scheduling for a later date needs Pro or Business. Facebook, LinkedIn and X are not live yet. VEXI posts to Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Threads and your Google Business Profile.
Does Submagic make posts and carousels?
No. Submagic edits video. VEXI also designs posts and carousels in your logo, colors and fonts, and writes their captions.
Starter is $19 a month ($12 billed yearly) for about 15 videos up to 2 minutes, Pro is $39 ($23) for about 40 videos up to 5 minutes, and Business is $69 ($41) for about 100 videos up to 30 minutes.
What do Trustpilot reviewers say about Submagic?
Submagic is rated 4.5 on Trustpilot. Some reviewers report that stopping the payments is unnecessarily hard and refund requests refused.
